questions.objective: Assess psychological resilience, stress tolerance, and emotional stability
questions.patient_text: How do you usually handle stress, illness, or painful situations? (Satva)

options.label: Very resilient — Stay calm, focused, patient, and adhere well to treatment (Pravara)
Moderate — Manage with some effort, feel occasional stress but recover reasonably (Madhyama)
Sensitive — Get easily overwhelmed, anxious, or lose confidence during illness/stress (Avara)
